title: Creation of the sky, sun, moon, and stars
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Outcomes d to h in this file belong to a reading-the-Bible sub-strand folded in by the text layer; a reviewer should check them against the printed KICD design.

skills.key_step: The child says God created the sun, moon and stars on the fourth day (Genesis 1:14-19) and what each does.

floor.prerequisite: Knows God created plants and animals.
floor.question: Who created plants and animals?

representations: pictures of the sun, moon and stars
steps: Say who made the lights and on which day.
contexts: a starry night in the village

board.say: What did God make on this day?

board.do: Wait for the child to say the sun, moon and stars.

misconceptions.ask: Who created the sun, moon and stars?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 1:16. People make bulbs; God made the sun.

misconceptions.ask: On which day did God make the sun, moon and stars?
misconceptions.repair: Count the days of creation on fingers to four.
Draw a day sky and a night sky and place each light.

misconceptions.ask: What are the lights in the sky for, says Genesis 1:14?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 1:14 and link with days and seasons.

skills.key_step: The child lists why Christians read the Bible and says Psalm 119:105.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how to handle the Bible with respect.
floor.question: How should we handle the Bible?

representations: a torch for the lamp picture
steps: List reasons to read the Bible.
contexts: a child choosing right over wrong

board.say: How is God's word like a lamp?

board.do: Wait for the child to say it shows the way.
List reasons to read the Bible.

misconceptions.ask: Can children read the Bible too?
misconceptions.repair: Show a children's Bible and read a verse together.

misconceptions.ask: What does "your word is a lamp for my feet" mean?
misconceptions.repair: Walk a dark path with a torch: it shows where to step. God's word shows how to live.

misconceptions.ask: Why do Christians read the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Name a story and its lesson for life.

misconceptions.ask: When can a family read the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Make a "verse of the day" chart for the week.

checks.question: Name a reason to read the Bible.
Complete: your word is a lamp...
checks.answer: for my feet, a light on my path
